title: Cloudflare MCP Server
summary: Point your agent at Cloudflare's hosted API MCP server to manage Workers, R2, DNS and other products and to search the Cloudflare docs.
description: Cloudflare's current MCP server covers its whole public API through three tools: one to search endpoints, one to call them and one to search the developer docs. The agent writes small scripts that run in an isolated sandbox on Cloudflare's side.
You sign in with OAuth and pick the permissions to grant. For automation, a scoped API token can be sent as a bearer token instead.
useWhen: Check DNS records for a zone before a migration
List Workers and their latest deploys
Find the right Cloudflare API endpoint for a task
Look up a limit or setting in the Cloudflare docs

mcp.name: cloudflare
access: Cloudflare accounts, zones and products allowed by the permissions you approve
Can change DNS, Workers and storage if you grant write permissions

example.prompt: List the DNS records for example.com that point at an IP address and tell me which are proxied.
example.result: 3 A records: example.com (proxied), api.example.com (proxied), mail.example.com (DNS only).

faq.question: Which permissions should I grant?
faq.answer: Start with read access to the zones you need. Add write access only for the task at hand.

faq.question: Is the old per-product server list still needed?
faq.answer: No. Several separate servers such as Workers Builds and Radar are marked deprecated in favor of this API server.

access: Acts on your Cloudflare account within the approved permissions
